title: REQ · Manifest loader reports missing asset files without throwing
summary: A loader reads a manifest file and reports referenced files missing on disk.
description: Context: parseManifest validates shape only, not that files exist. Desired behavior: loadManifestFile(manifestPath, assetsRoot) reads JSON, runs parseManifest, and for each asset checks the file exists under assetsRoot, returning {ok, data, errors} with path-named issues and never throwing on missing or malformed files. Expected result: dangling paths are reported clearly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a manifest with all files present, when loaded, then ok is true
Given an entry whose file is absent, when loaded, then ok is false with an issue naming assets.<i>.path
Given a missing or malformed manifest file, when loaded, then ok is false and nothing throws
